**Test plan is live: [chirp#60](https://github.com/pablof7z/chirp/issues/60) — 70 scenarios** (S01–S70), each with a "perfect" acceptance list, required perf metrics, and relay/offline criteria, grounded in the real iOS surface. Two things the Opus author caught by reading source instead of trusting assumptions: [...] - **Zap UI is still in the code** — PR #58's "removed zaps entirely" didn't fully land. The sweep will confirm actual state (S28/S33/S54), and it'll get fixed properly.
- **Search was deleted** (chirp#27) — so no search scenarios. [...] 3. **File + fix + reverify** — anything broken (offline-first, rendering, UX, perf, relay diagnostics) becomes a GH issue, gets fixed, and gets re-tested. No hand-waving, no hacks.
4. **Opus final review** — an Opus agent reviews *every* screenshot before anything is called done; anything short of perfect (padding/margins, data, relay diagnostics, perf) goes back to step 3.
